Glass Works & Hardware

From design glass and toughened glass doors to partitions and window glass, we cut, finish and fit glass to your measurements. Alongside the glass work, our shop stocks the fittings that go with it: glass fittings, screws and nails, plus MDF and plywood for wood works.

Whether you are building a new home, renovating a shop or fitting out an office, you can get the glass, the hardware and the boards from one place, in wholesale quantities or as a single piece.

About Us

Shanmuga Glass House is a glass and hardware shop in Sivakasi, Tamil Nadu, serving both retail customers and wholesale buyers. We help you choose the right glass design, door or material for your space and supply it with the fittings to finish the job.

Visit us on Police Station Road, opposite the Town Police Station, or call or WhatsApp us to discuss what you need.
